case_title: Anbazhagan v. The State Represented by the Inspector of Police
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s. 304-I of the IPC
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s. 304-II of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused and the deceased were agriculturists with adjacent land. A dispute arose over a pathway, leading to a verbal altercation. The accused hit the deceased with a hoe on the head, causing unconsciousness and subsequent death. The deceased sustained internal head injuries, and the accused was initially convicted of culpable homicide not amounting to murder. The Supreme Court altered the conviction to culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s. 304-II of the IPC and sentenced the accused to five years rigorous imprisonment.
